title: CB + TEAP
description: Cubic Bottles version that supports TEAP!
body:
This is a "minor" version of [Cubic Bottles](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cubic-bottles) that supports [TEAP](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/theones-eating-animation-pack). [TEAP](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/theones-eating-animation-pack) is not required but kinda recomended to use with it! Place in this order so it works:
![idk](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d5e886ca9aa21fa61d766b3ab49b17405e26c1c.png) Please visit [Cubic Bottles](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cubic-bottles) and [TEAP](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/theones-eating-animation-pack) original pages, thanks :>
